content.comment_body: How do you connect a PNP (3-wire) inductive sensor to a [product_name] 24 RC module?

Hello [user_name], You may find information helpful at: [url] Based on my understanding, connect the positive wire to L+, the negative wire to M, and the signal wire to an input on the [product_name] module. Depending on the sensor output, it may be necessary to connect a resistor between the signal input and the negative wire before connecting to the module.

If the power supply for the [product_name] 24RCE is DC24V (not AC24V), connect L+(DC24V) to P1 and M(0V) to P2. There's no need for an extra resistor if your module uses PNP inputs. Simply connect lead 1 (brown) to P1 (L+), and lead 3 (blue) to P2 (M). For a normally closed contact, connect lead 2 (white) to any of the inputs I1...I8; for a normally open contact, connect lead 4 (black) to the same input range. Do not mix AC24V and DC24V power supplies at the base module. Regards, [user_name]
